import Mathlib

/-- Compute 2^11 mod 23 equals 1 -/
lemma pow_2_11_mod_23 : 2 ^ 11 % 23 = 1 := by norm_num

/-- Powers of 2 mod 23 repeat with period 11 -/
lemma pow_2_cycle_mod_23 (k : ℕ) : 2 ^ k % 23 = 2 ^ (k % 11) % 23 := by sorry

/-- For positive n, 23 | 2^n - 1 implies 11 | n -/
lemma h02_a_forward (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (h : 23 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1) : 11 ∣ n := by sorry

/-- For positive n, 11 | n implies 23 | 2^n - 1 -/
lemma h02_a_backward (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (h : 11 ∣ n) : 23 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 := by sorry

/-- No positive n satisfies 2^n ≡ -1 (mod 23) -/
lemma h02_b_helper (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ¬(2 ^ n % 23 = 22) := by sorry

/-- (a): 23 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 iff 11 ∣ n, for positive n. -/
theorem h02_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 23 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 11 ∣ n := by
  constructor
  · exact h02_a_forward n hn
  · exact h02_a_backward n hn

/-- (b): no positive n has 23 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1. -/
theorem h02_b (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ¬23 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1 := by
  intro h
  have h₁ : 2 ^ n % 23 = 22 := by omega
  exact h02_b_helper n hn h₁

import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
set_option exponentiation.threshold 10000
set_option maxRecDepth 8000

/-- Helper: Powers of 2 mod 23 repeat with period 11 -/
lemma pow_2_cycle_mod_23 (n : ℕ) : 2 ^ n % 23 = 2 ^ (n % 11) % 23 := by sorry

/-- Helper: 2^k mod 23 never equals 22 for k in [0, 10] -/
lemma pow_2_neq_neg1_mod_23 (k : ℕ) (hk : k < 11) : 2 ^ k % 23 ≠ 22 := by sorry

/-- Forward direction: if 11 | n then 23 | 2^n - 1 -/
lemma h02_a_forward (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (h : 11 ∣ n) : 23 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 := by sorry

-- Check each residue class for part (a) backward direction
lemma pow_2_residue_0 : 2 ^ 0 % 23 = 1 := by norm_num
lemma pow_2_residue_1 : 2 ^ 1 % 23 = 2 := by norm_num
lemma pow_2_residue_2 : 2 ^ 2 % 23 = 4 := by norm_num
lemma pow_2_residue_3 : 2 ^ 3 % 23 = 8 := by norm_num
lemma pow_2_residue_4 : 2 ^ 4 % 23 = 16 := by norm_num
lemma pow_2_residue_5 : 2 ^ 5 % 23 = 9 := by norm_num
lemma pow_2_residue_6 : 2 ^ 6 % 23 = 18 := by norm_num
lemma pow_2_residue_7 : 2 ^ 7 % 23 = 13 := by norm_num
lemma pow_2_residue_8 : 2 ^ 8 % 23 = 3 := by norm_num
lemma pow_2_residue_9 : 2 ^ 9 % 23 = 6 := by norm_num
lemma pow_2_residue_10 : 2 ^ 10 % 23 = 12 := by norm_num

-- For any k < 11, 2^k ≠ 1 mod 23 except when k = 0
lemma pow_2_eq_one_iff_k_zero (k : ℕ) (hk : k < 11) : 2 ^ k % 23 = 1 ↔ k = 0 := by sorry

-- If n % 11 ≠ 0 then 2^n ≢ 1 mod 23
lemma pow_2_not_cong_one_if_not_div_by_11 (n : ℕ) (h : ¬(11 ∣ n)) : ¬(2 ^ n % 23 = 1) := by sorry

-- Backward direction: if 23 | 2^n - 1 then 11 | n
lemma h02_a_backward (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 23 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 → 11 ∣ n := by sorry

-- Main theorem (a): both directions combined
theorem h02_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 23 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 11 ∣ n := by sorry

-- For part (b), combine cycle lemma with residue check
theorem h02_b (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ¬23 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1 := by sorry
